name: OSC 1 Engine

name: OSC 1 Table

name: OSC 1 Wave

name: OSC 1 Tune

name: OSC 1 Fine

name: OSC 1 Pan

name: OSC 1 Phase

name: OSC 1 Free Run
tip: On: the oscillator keeps running between notes instead of restarting, for a looser analogue feel.

name: OSC 1 Keytrack
tip: How much the pitch follows the keyboard. 0% gives a fixed pitch for drones and effects.
caption: Keytrack

name: OSC 1 Unison
tip: Number of stacked, detuned copies (1 to 16). More voices sound thicker but cost more CPU.
caption: Unison

name: OSC 1 Detune

caption: Detune

name: OSC 1 Width
tip: Stereo spread of the unison voices (additive mode spreads odd and even partials instead).
caption: Width

name: OSC 1 FX 1
